name: Draw Topology (COMPAS CEM)
description: Draw a topology diagram in color, with its deviation edges dashed and its loaded nodes crossed. The outputs are Rhino model objects: a Model Object or Data parameter keeps their colors and plot weights, a Line, Curve or Point parameter only their geometry. Press bake to add the drawing to the Rhino document.

inputParameters.name: node_keys
inputParameters.description: A selection of the node keys in the diagram, which also selects the load crosses drawn. Defaults to all the node keys.

inputParameters.name: edge_keys
inputParameters.description: A selection of the edge keys in the diagram. Defaults to all the edge keys.

inputParameters.name: show_keys
inputParameters.description: Whether to label the drawn nodes with their keys and the drawn edges with u-v in the viewport. The labels do not bake. Defaults to False.

inputParameters.name: bake
inputParameters.description: Whether to add the drawing to the Rhino document. Wire a Button, so every press bakes once: lines with their colors and plot weights, and deviation edges dashed, each category on its own sublayer of COMPAS CEM::Topology. The labels do not bake.

outputParameters.name: nodes
outputParameters.description: The nodes as points: green at a support, purple at an origin, light gray otherwise.

outputParameters.name: origin_nodes
outputParameters.description: The origin nodes as purple points.

outputParameters.name: support_nodes
outputParameters.description: The support nodes as green points.

outputParameters.name: edges
outputParameters.description: The edges as lines, blue in compression and red in tension by their length or force, orange on an auxiliary trail, with the deviation edges dashed.

outputParameters.name: trail_edges
outputParameters.description: The trail edges as lines, colored as in edges.

outputParameters.name: deviation_edges
outputParameters.description: The deviation edges as dashed lines, colored as in edges.

outputParameters.name: trails
outputParameters.description: The trails as pink polylines, orange for an auxiliary trail.

outputParameters.name: loads
outputParameters.description: A black cross at every loaded node, as two lines each in the XY plane.
